items.title: Library Book Sale
items.text: The town library will hold a book sale this Saturday from nine o'clock to noon. Story books cost one dollar, and big picture books cost two dollars. All the money will buy new chairs for the reading room. Please bring your own bag. If it rains, the sale will move inside the gym.

qs.q: What will the library buy with the money from the sale?
qs.why: 본문에 'All the money will buy new chairs for the reading room.'이라고 나와 있어요.

qs.q: Ben buys two story books and one big picture book. How much does he pay?
qs.why: 이야기책은 한 권에 1달러, 큰 그림책은 2달러예요. 1 + 1 + 2 = 4달러가 돼요.

qs.q: In the first sentence, "hold" means:
qs.why: 'hold a book sale'은 책 판매 행사를 '연다, 개최한다'는 뜻이라 'have or organize'가 맞아요.

qs.q: Why was this text written?
o: To ask people to give old books
To explain how to borrow books
To say the library will close
qs.why: 토요일 책 판매 행사의 시간, 가격, 장소를 알리는 안내문이에요.

items.title: My First Swimming Lesson
items.text: Tuesday, June 4. Today I had my first swimming lesson. The water was cold, so I felt nervous. My teacher held my hands and showed me how to kick. After twenty minutes, I could float on my back! I was so proud that I told everyone about it at dinner.

qs.q: How long did it take before the writer could float?
qs.why: 'After twenty minutes, I could float on my back!'이라고 했어요.

qs.q: What can we guess about the writer before today?
o: The writer could not float yet
The writer was afraid of dinner
qs.why: 오늘 처음 수업을 듣고 20분 뒤에야 뜰 수 있게 되었으니, 전에는 물에 뜨지 못했다고 추측할 수 있어요.

qs.q: In this diary, "float" means:
o: stay on top of the water
qs.why: 'float on my back'은 등을 대고 물 위에 떠 있는 것이므로 'stay on top of the water'예요.

qs.q: What is the diary mainly about?
o: A first lesson in the pool
qs.why: 전체 내용이 처음 받은 수영 수업에서 있었던 일과 기분이에요.

items.title: Picnic at Maple Park
items.text: Hi Dana, we are having a picnic at Maple Park on Sunday at noon. Please bring a drink and a blanket. I will make sandwiches, and Leo will bring a ball for games. Can you tell me by Friday if you can come? Your friend, Kim

qs.q: What does Kim ask Dana to bring?
qs.why: 'Please bring a drink and a blanket.'이라고 부탁했어요.

qs.q: Why does Kim want an answer by Friday?
o: The park will close on Saturday
Leo may be too busy to play
The blanket must be washed first
qs.why: 미리 올 사람 수를 알아야 샌드위치 등을 준비할 수 있으므로, 인원을 알려고 답을 요청했다고 추측할 수 있어요.

qs.q: In "Can you tell me by Friday if you can come?", "by Friday" means:
qs.why: 'by Friday'는 '늦어도 금요일까지'라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why did Kim write this email?
o: To invite Dana to a picnic
To say sorry for being late
To thank Leo for the sandwiches
qs.why: 일요일 소풍에 올 수 있는지 묻는 초대 이메일이에요.

items.title: Min's Bean Seeds
items.text: Min planted three bean seeds in a small pot and put it near the window. Every morning, she gave them a little water. For a week, nothing happened. Then, on Monday, a tiny green leaf came out of the soil. Min jumped up and ran to show her brother.

qs.q: When did Min water the seeds?
qs.why: 'Every morning, she gave them a little water.'라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why did Min jump up?
o: She wanted to move the pot
She was angry at her brother
qs.why: 일주일 동안 기다리다 작은 잎이 나오자 신이 나서 뛰어올랐다고 추측할 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the story, "soil" means:
o: a part of the window by the pot
the ground that plants grow in
a small green bean from the seeds
a pot made of clay or plastic
qs.why: 잎이 'came out of the soil'이라고 했으니 식물이 자라는 흙을 뜻해요.

qs.q: In "she gave them a little water," "them" means:
qs.why: 'them'은 앞 문장의 'three bean seeds'를 가리켜요. 잎은 아직 나오지 않은 때예요.

items.title: Life in a Beehive
items.text: Honeybees live together in a hive. One bee, called the queen, lays eggs. Other bees collect sweet juice from flowers and turn it into honey. A worker bee may visit hundreds of flowers in one day. Bees also carry pollen, which helps plants make seeds.

qs.q: Which bee lays the eggs?
qs.why: 'One bee, called the queen, lays eggs.'라고 했어요.

qs.q: What would probably happen if there were no bees?
qs.why: 벌이 꽃가루를 옮겨 식물이 씨를 만들도록 돕는다고 했으니, 벌이 없으면 씨가 줄 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the passage, "collect" means:
qs.why: 꽃에서 단 즙을 모은다는 뜻이므로 'gather(모으다)'와 같은 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: How to make honey at home
qs.why: 벌집 생활, 여왕벌, 일벌, 꿀과 꽃가루 등 벌이 사는 모습과 하는 일을 설명해요.

items.title: Bus 5 Is Late
items.text: Attention, students. Because of the heavy snow, Bus 5 will leave school later today. It will leave at 4:00 instead of 3:30. Students who ride Bus 5 should wait in the library. A teacher will call your name when the bus arrives. Please do not wait outside.

qs.q: Where should Bus 5 students wait?
qs.why: 'Students who ride Bus 5 should wait in the library.'라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why are students asked not to wait outside?
qs.why: 눈이 많이 와서 버스가 늦어지는 상황이므로, 날씨 때문에 밖에서 기다리지 말라고 한 것으로 추측할 수 있어요.

qs.q: In "It will leave at 4:00 instead of 3:30," "instead of" means:
qs.why: '4:00 instead of 3:30'은 3시 30분 '대신' 4시에 떠난다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What is the announcement mainly about?
o: A change in the bus time
A snow day with no school
qs.why: 5번 버스의 출발 시간이 3시 30분에서 4시로 바뀐다는 내용이에요.

items.title: A Visit to the Dentist
items.text: Friday, March 8. I went to the dentist after school. I was afraid of the big chair, but the dentist spoke softly and explained every step. There were no holes in my teeth. "Keep brushing twice a day," the dentist said. Mom bought me a small toy as a reward.

qs.q: How often should the writer brush?
qs.why: 'Keep brushing twice a day'라고 했으니 하루에 두 번이에요.

qs.q: What probably helped the writer feel less afraid?
o: The toy in the waiting room
The empty chair near the door
qs.why: 치과의사가 부드럽게 말하고 모든 단계를 설명해 주었으므로 두려움이 줄었을 거예요.

qs.q: In the diary, "reward" means:
o: money paid to the dentist after a visit
a rule that you must follow
a tool that the doctor uses on teeth
qs.why: 엄마가 장난감을 사 준 것은 잘한 일에 대한 보상이므로 'something given for doing well'이에요.

qs.q: What is the diary mainly about?
o: A calm visit to the dentist
A broken tooth and a long pain
A fun day at the toy shop
qs.why: 무서웠지만 치과 방문이 순조롭게 끝난 하루를 쓴 일기예요.

items.title: The Early Bakery
items.text: Every morning at five, Mr. Oh opens his bakery. The smell of warm bread fills the street. Today a small girl stood outside the window and stared at a round cake. Mr. Oh smiled, put a cookie in a paper bag, and handed it to her. She said, "Thank you!" and ran off.

qs.q: What did Mr. Oh give the girl?
qs.why: 'put a cookie in a paper bag, and handed it to her'라고 했어요.

qs.q: What can we guess about Mr. Oh?
qs.why: 케이크를 바라보던 아이에게 웃으며 쿠키를 건넸으니 친절하다고 추측할 수 있어요.

qs.q: "Stared at" means:
o: looked at for a long time
laughed at it in a loud voice
qs.why: 창밖에 서서 케이크를 오래 바라보았다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What is the story mainly about?
o: A girl who learns to bake bread
A shop that changes its opening hours
A cake that is sold at a high price
A baker and a girl outside his shop
qs.why: 빵집 주인과 창밖에서 케이크를 바라보던 아이 사이에 일어난 일을 다룬 이야기예요.

items.title: Penguins
items.text: Penguins are birds, but they cannot fly. Their wings work like flippers, so they swim fast in cold water. Many penguins live near the South Pole. In one kind of penguin, the mother lays an egg, and then the father keeps it warm on his feet until it hatches.

qs.q: What do a penguin's wings work like?
qs.why: 'Their wings work like flippers'라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why does the father keep the egg on his feet?
o: To hide it from the mother
To keep it warm in the cold
To help it learn to swim
To move it to the South Pole
qs.why: 아빠 펭귄이 알을 발 위에 두고 따뜻하게 지켜 준다고 했어요. 추운 곳에서 알을 따뜻하게 하려는 것이에요.

qs.q: "Hatches" means:
qs.why: 알이 따뜻하게 유지되다가 새끼가 알을 깨고 나오는 것을 뜻해요.

qs.q: In the second sentence, "they" (in "so they swim fast") refers to:
qs.why: 'they swim fast'에서 헤엄치는 것은 앞에서 말한 펭귄이에요. 날개는 헤엄치지 않아요.

items.title: Email to a Teacher
items.text: Dear Mr. Choi, Ari cannot come to school tomorrow morning because of a doctor's appointment at ten o'clock. We will arrive after lunch. Could you please tell me which homework Ari will miss? Thank you for your help. Best wishes, Ari's parent

qs.q: What does the writer ask Mr. Choi?
qs.why: 'Could you please tell me which homework Ari will miss?'라고 물었어요.

qs.q: What will Ari probably miss tomorrow?
qs.why: 아침에 병원 예약이 있고 점심 후에 학교에 도착하므로 오전 수업을 놓칠 거예요.

qs.q: "Appointment" means:
o: a planned time to meet someone
a kind of homework for the week
a long trip taken with a school
a short break for eating lunch
qs.why: 'doctor's appointment'은 의사를 만나기로 정해 둔 시간, 즉 진료 예약이에요.

qs.q: Why did the writer send this email?
o: To explain why Ari will be late
To ask for a new class
To invite the teacher to lunch
qs.why: Ari가 병원 진료 때문에 내일 학교에 늦게 간다는 것을 알리려고 쓴 이메일이에요.
